comments.note: hcMcpDist, hcMcpDistFresh, hcOrcVenv are resolved via HEALTH_CHECKS.find() at module load time. If a health-check ID were renamed in health-checks.js, the find() would return undefined and the subsequent .detect() call would throw TypeError at runtime. Current IDs are stable, but a future ID rename would be a silent latent bug. Consider adding assertive guards (e.g. if (!hcMcpDist) throw new Error('health-check mcp-dist not found')) to fail fast at startup rather than at the first preflight run.
VENV_DIR retention is correct: venvBin() still uses it for the preflight-specific orchestrate binary check. The developer comment on this point is accurate and sufficient.
No blocking issues. All 4 ACs confirmed met. Refactoring is clean: duplicate mtime logic eliminated, one-way import maintained, checkVenv() cleanly separates shared vs preflight-specific detection.
